reason: B is more physically credible because an external aluminide reservoir can form a continuous alumina diffusion barrier while minimizing changes to the load-bearing bulk alloy, whereas 5 at.% Cr is unlikely to establish a continuous CrTaO4 scale in the highly reactive, Ti/Zr/Hf-rich substrate and may precipitate embrittling Laves phases. B still needs a defined coating composition/thickness, longer exposures, and supporting citations, but it provides the more direct and testable intervention.
